description: This file defines the UserInformationDisplayDriver class, which manages the display and update logic for user information in the OrchardCore CMS, including handling permissions, validation, and editing of user details like username, email, and phone number.

classes.name: UserInformationDisplayDriver
classes.description: A display driver for managing user information display and editing in OrchardCore, including permission checks, validation, and conditional editing of user properties.

methods.name: UserInformationDisplayDriver
methods.description: Constructor initializing dependencies for user info display driver.

methods.name: EditAsync
methods.description: Prepares the display for editing user information, setting up models for username, email, and phone number with appropriate permissions.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Handles updating user information based on submitted form data, including validation and permission checks.

methods.name: CanEditUserInfoAsync
methods.description: Checks if the current user can edit the specified user's information.

methods.name: IsCurrentUser
methods.description: Determines if the specified user is the current logged-in user.
